reasoning: On the season so far the Magic are the stronger team; with home court the Magic start about 1 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Magic.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Magic win 54 times in 100, by about 1; most games like this end between 196 and 245 total points.
